concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-cegid-retail-y2-tap-to-pay]] — 2026-09-15 Cegid mobile Tap to Pay guide separating iPhone iOS Mobile SDK/InStoreHub/v18+ from Android Payments app credentials, merchant/store IDs, Support enablement and device-security gates; setup is not payment proof.
warnings: Do not merge iPhone Mobile SDK requirements with Android's standalone Adyen Payments app or the overview's lower Retail Y2 host-version floor.
The iPhone Developer Mode testing instruction differs from Android's Developer Options OFF security check for transactions.
Merchant Account ID and Store ID are distinct from Company Account ID and store reference; configuration and displayed results do not prove merchant approval or payment finality.
